name: Brown Doori Sanbanme
source:
The setting is Middle Ages, a time where peace and war is jumbled together.
It is during this time that utility people called "Adventurers" came into existence.
Monster extermination, ruins exploration, getting back stolen goods, etc.
As long as you have rewards and policy, they're an extremely useful existence.

To those people, weapons and goods necessary for adventure are sold, requests are dispatched and wounded bodies are tended and nursed.
An extremely essential existence for them adventurers that is, "Adventurer's Bar".

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=21427]Getchu[/url]]

Business simulator from Softhouse Chara.
Create commodities to sell, dispatch requests to adventurers and upgrade your shop.
Can you turn a profit?
translation:
故事發生在和平與戰爭彼此交織的中世紀。
就在這個時代，一群被稱為「冒險者」的什麼差事都能接的好手應運而生。
討伐怪物、探索遺蹟、奪回贓物……
只要報酬合適、原則允許，他們就是值得託付的人選。

有一個地方向冒險者出售武器和冒險必需品、發布委託，也為負傷者提供治療與照料。
那就是對冒險者而言不可或缺的「冒險者酒館」。

[翻譯自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=21427]Getchu[/url]]

本作是Softhouse Chara製作的模擬經營遊戲。
製造商品並出售，向冒險者發布委託，升級自己的店面。
你能賺到利潤嗎？
